protocol: Nested CV: inner stratified 3-fold for all scaling, feature selection and hyperparameter search. Pooled scheme: outer stratified 5-fold (seed 42). LOSO: each fold holds out one whole source. ComBat / z-score harmonisation, when used, is fit on the outer-train fold only. B block: per-parcel time-series statistics + per-subject brain states (see build_r4b_features.py).
